name: Pinehurst
question_title: Can you drive a golf cart in Pinehurst?
answer_short: Yes, with a village sticker, except the named roads. In Pinehurst, golf carts may use streets posted 35 mph or less. They may not drive on NC 211 or US 15-501 except to cross at a traffic signal, and they may not drive on NC 2, NC 5, Morganton Road, Page Road or Linden Road.

golf_cart.roads: Village streets posted 35 mph or less, not the named roads

rules.rule: Streets posted 35 mph or less. Not NC 211 or US 15-501 except a signalized crossing. Not NC 2, NC 5, Morganton Road, Page Road or Linden Road except to cross.
No golf carts on Page Drive, Aviemore Drive, Memorial Drive or Regional Drive
Registered, insured LSVs on roads posted 35 mph or less; may cross faster roads at intersections

banned_roads.name: NC 2, NC 5, Morganton Road, Page Road, Linden Road
Page Drive, Aviemore Drive, Memorial Drive, Regional Drive

faq.q: Where can I drive my LSV in Pinehurst?
faq.a: Roads posted 35 mph or less. Registered and insured. A town or county can still ban LSVs from a specific road, and posted signs win.

faq.q: Can I drive a golf cart on NC 211 in Pinehurst?
faq.a: No, except to cross it at a traffic signal.

faq.q: Do I need a sticker in Pinehurst?
faq.a: Yes. The village requires a registration sticker on the front and rear.
